name: How do I choose the right real estate agent for my landlord exit strategy?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right real estate agent for my landlord exit strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a real estate agent for your exit strategy, look for someone with experience in investment properties and a deep understanding of local market conditions in your specific area, such as Broward or Palm Beach County. A good agent will provide a comprehensive market analysis, advise on preparing the property, and skillfully negotiate on your behalf. Consider an agent who can clearly articulate their marketing plan and provide references from other landlord clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agent with investment property expertise, local market knowledge, and a clear plan for your exit strategy.
